name: Graveyard counts of spells and fired abilities
notes: Counts asked as a typed X or not read. Your graveyard: Craw Wurm (mana value 6), Diligent Farmhand, Llanowar Elves, Shock, Divination, Muscle Burst, Ancestral Anger, Kjeldoran War Cry. Muscle Burst on Grizzly Bears: 3 plus Muscle Burst and Diligent Farmhand (it counts as one for Muscle Burst) = +5/+5, 7/7. Ancestral Anger on Hill Giant: 1 + 1 = +2/+0 and trample, 5/3. The opponent's Kjeldoran War Cry: 1 + 1 in all graveyards, their Craw Wurm +2/+2. Wick's Patrol's trigger ("Mill three cards" done): the greatest mana value in your graveyard, -6/-6 on that Craw Wurm, 2/0. Gloom Ripper's trigger on Goblin Guide: Elves you control (Gloom Ripper) plus Elf cards in your graveyard (Llanowar Elves) = +2/+0, 4/2. A third player's Candlekeep Inspiration: Shock and Divination in their graveyard, Lightning Bolt and Bonecrusher Giant (an Adventure) in their exile, a face-down card there not counted, = 4: their Elvish Mystic is 4/4.

scryfallData.name: Craw Wurm
scryfallData.flavor_text: The most terrifying thing about the craw wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

scryfallData.name: Elvish Mystic
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"The Three Rings of the Elves were not made as weapons of war or conquest—that is not their power. Those who made them did not desire strength or domination or hoarded wealth, but understanding, making, and healing, to preserve all things unstained."
—Elrond

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.
